notes: University of Auckland Vaka Moana Scholarship is a first-year undergraduate equity/assistance scholarship (up to NZ$24,000: one year catered accommodation plus a laptop) for Indigenous Pacific students. Official page verified (https://www.auckland.ac.nz/en/study/scholarships-and-awards/find-a-scholarship/uoa-vaka-moana-scholarship-1080-all.html): 'A Scholarship to support Indigenous Pacific students enrolling in their first year of undergraduate study... For: Assistance with study'. The award has no research or supervisory component and names no supervising professors, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable.

Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship (University of Waikato). Stored URL (waikato.ac.nz/assets/Uploads/VCIES-2026-all-other-countries-v2.pdf) now 404s; current official page verified at https://www.waikato.ac.nz/study/scholarships/find-a-scholarship/vice-chancellors-international-excellence-scholarship and current regulations at https://www.waikato.ac.nz/assets/Uploads/Study-with-us/Scholarships/Find-a-Scholarship/VCIES-2026-all-other-countries-v2.pdf. Page states 'Study level(s) Undergraduate, Postgraduate (Taught)' and regulations state 'all undergraduate and postgraduate programmes except the Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) and Master of Philosophy (MPhil) are eligible'. Merit-based tuition-fee award with no supervision component and no named professors.

Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship for International Students (University of Otago). Stored URL (otago.ac.nz/courses/scholarships/vice-chancellors-international-postgraduate-scholarships) 404s; the live official page was verified at https://www.otago.ac.nz/study/scholarships/vice-chancellors-scholarship-for-international-students. It is an undergraduate Entrance Scholarship (NZD$10,000, one-year tenure, tuition credit) for international school-leavers enrolling in first-year undergraduate study; selection based on 'Academic potential, as demonstrated by programme admission'. No supervisory component; no professors named.

University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship is a university-wide award: 'There are four University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarships available per year - one per teaching Division' (verified at https://www.otago.ac.nz/study/scholarships/master; the stored /courses/scholarships/ URL and the /study/scholarships/university-of-otago-international-masters-research-scholarship detail URL both currently return 404). Selection is 'based predominantly on academic merit and the applicant's potential for research' via eVision; no supervising professor is attached to or named by the scholarship. The listing page notes the award is 'Currently suspended' in all four Divisions (Commerce, Health Sciences, Humanities, Sciences). No official page ties any named professor to this award, so no verified supervisors could be recorded.

University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship page verified live at https://www.otago.ac.nz/courses/scholarships/university-of-otago-doctoral-scholarship (NZ$34,128 stipend plus domestic tuition waiver for 36 months; up to 153 awards annually). It is the University's main institution-wide doctoral award for all academic divisions and professional doctorates. Per https://www.otago.ac.nz/courses/scholarships/phd, applications are made online through eVision 'with a completed departmental assessment'; the page notes Otago is currently reviewing its doctoral scholarship programme. The scholarship names no supervising professors on any official page (only the Scholarships Office contact scholarships@otago.ac.nz), so no supervisors could be verified for the award itself; supervisors are arranged through departments at admission, not via the scholarship.

Konstanty Kalinowski Scholarship Programme is a Polish Government national programme for Belarusian students; supervisor enrichment is not applicable (national scheme with no single attached institution). Stored URL (study.gov.pl/konstanty-kalinowski-scholarship-programme) now 404s. Programme documents confirm the scheme is implemented by the University of Warsaw - Centre for East European Studies with the Ministry of Science and Higher Education and Ministry of Foreign Affairs (https://studium.uw.edu.pl/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Kalinowski_2026_Program-I_EN.pdf): qualified recipients 'independently apply for studies' and 'Qualified scholarship recipients have gone on to study at 83 universities across Poland', so no fixed supervising professors are tied to the programme. Programme office contact (institutional, not a supervisor): bialorus.studium@uw.edu.pl.

Ulam NAWA Programme: stored URL (nawa.gov.pl/blad-404) is a dead link; live official pages verified at https://nawa.gov.pl/en/scientists/the-ulam-programme and https://nawa.gov.pl/en/nawa/news/call-for-proposals-ulam-nawa-2026. This is a Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (national agency) programme in which 'The applicant and beneficiary of the funding is the host institution in Poland' and projects employ an invited Principal Investigator (6-24 months, up to PLN 436,800/project). It is a national scheme with no attached institution or named supervisors; the 'Inviting Person' is specific to each host institution's project rather than the programme, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable. Programme contact: ulam@nawa.gov.pl.
